about: Zetwerk operates a technology-led, asset-light manufacturing platform for industrial and consumer goods in India and globally. Unified through its proprietary Zetwerk OS, the platform aggregates capacity across thousands of third-party suppliers and selective owned facilities. It serves diverse sectors including renewables, consumer electronics, aerospace, defence, and capital goods.

promoters.background: Both Promoters graduated from IIT Madras and began their professional careers at ITC before co-founding Zetwerk in December 2017.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers accounted for 35.90% of continuing operations revenue in FY26; top 10 suppliers contributed 38.18% of total continuing expenses.

litigation_note: The group has outstanding legal and tax matters with contingent liabilities totalling ₹1,144.55 crore as of June 30, 2026, including ₹379.29 crore corporate guarantees and ₹650.20 crore bank guarantees.
strengths: Proprietary Zetwerk OS platform enables end-to-end workflow automation and distributed simultaneous manufacturing.
Capital-efficient hybrid model combines a large 6,979-supplier network with 26 selective owned manufacturing facilities.
Strong customer stickiness with repeat customers contributing 80.15% of Manufacturing Business revenue in FY26.
Substantial Manufacturing Order Book of ₹12,370.01 crore in FY26 providing solid multi-year revenue visibility.
Terra91 ecosystem business leverages aggregated scale to secure competitive raw material pricing.
Diversified exposure across high-growth verticals including renewable energy, AI data centres, and precision defence products.
Experienced founding team from IIT Madras and ITC with proven execution capabilities across manufacturing cycles.

risks.title: History of net losses
risks.detail: Incurred restated continuing losses of ₹964.39 crore in FY26, ₹215.07 crore in FY25, and ₹852.53 crore in FY24, with total net loss of ₹1,606.17 crore in FY26.

risks.title: Persistent negative operating cash flows
risks.detail: Operating cash flow remained negative across all periods, standing at ₹-681.53 crore in FY26, ₹-386.29 crore in FY25, and ₹-281.54 crore in FY24.

risks.title: Substantial outstanding indebtedness
risks.detail: Consolidated total borrowings reached ₹5,208.07 crore as of August 31, 2026, posing significant debt servicing obligations.

risks.title: Supplier concentration risk
risks.detail: Top 10 suppliers contributed 38.18% of continuing expenses in FY26 and 39.59% in FY25, exposing operations to vendor disruptions.

risks.title: Customer concentration risk
risks.detail: Top 10 customers accounted for 35.90% of revenue from continuing operations in FY26 and 26.89% in FY25 without firm long-term volume commitments.

risks.title: Geographic revenue concentration
risks.detail: India and the USA accounted for 82.54% and 14.33% of continuing operations revenue in FY26, respectively, exposing the business to regional macro shifts.

risks.title: Contingent liabilities exposure
risks.detail: Contingent liabilities totalled ₹1,144.55 crore as of June 30, 2026, including ₹650.20 crore bank guarantees and ₹379.29 crore corporate guarantees.

risks.title: Promoter share pledge history
risks.detail: Prior to filing the RHP, 28,461,344 equity shares held by the Promoters were pledged under borrowing arrangements.

notes: Figures are restated consolidated. Discontinued operations (Civil Infrastructure Works) excluded from continuing revenue/PBT. Q1FY27 stub period (three months ended June 30, 2026) ignored in multi-year arrays. ROCE figures represent reported Manufacturing Business ROCE. P/E ratios are not ascertainable due to negative EPS.
